reason: First month is free and someone comes to my office to set it up, so I lose nothing by trying it. If it stops me phoning eight technicians all day, ₹199 a head is less than what I spend on their phone recharges, but I will only keep paying if it works in the field.
objection: My boys speak fast Tanglish on rooftops with the compressor running and traffic below. If the report comes out wrong even a few times and goes straight to my customer on WhatsApp, it makes my shop look bad. And my technicians already send me WhatsApp voice notes for free.
would_change_my_mind: If in the free month it gets the Tanglish reports wrong or my technicians stop pressing the button, I cancel. If it holds up, I pay.
